title: BlueHat IL 2023 - David Weston - Default Security
summary: David Weston's BlueHat IL 2023 talk traces the evolution of Windows security and previews Windows 11 and hardware advances. It ends with upcoming changes such as Rust in the kernel and fonts, signed binaries and adminless Windows.
why: HN uses it as the primary source for Microsoft's Rust adoption and its reasoning on TPM and security requirements.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The speaker covers a bunch of areas and the final part of the talk (around 10 minutes) is about Microsoft introducing Rust in some self-contained areas in Windows.
